description: Frozen inventory of the OLD selected slices (the replayable unit set chosen in the historical document-bench slicing work). Distinguishes: (a) selected slices, (b) mechanisms each slice covers, (c) parts of the old workload that were explicitly NOT sliced (unwrapped). Sources are the five evidence documents under legacy/evidence/ plus their original absolute paths recorded for provenance only.

ANALYSIS-python3123.md.scope: Python 3.12.3 white-box retest of the two OLD workloads (OPM single-applicant PDF, TLC XLSX) on the current image lineage; process/library/function composition, IPC, scheduling, syscalls.

AUTO_ANALYSIS-python3123.md.scope: Machine-generated per-process/DSO/symbol tables for the same runs.

REPORT-pdf10-weight.md.scope: N=10 PDF slice weight measurement (instructions:u / cycles:u per slice, 3 repeats, single CPU bound) and execution timeline.

README-slicing-pdf.md.scope: The six PDF slice definitions and standalone replay harness.

README-slicing-xlsx.md.scope: The eight XLSX slice definitions and standalone replay harness.
